notes.title: v0.35 ~ continuity
notes.content:
howdy friends, here’s a little somethin’ that’s been heavily requested from day 1.
[h3]THE “CONTINUE BUTTON”
[/h3]
you can probably guess what this one does:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/6919dff5474f407057fdccd36264c502ce174b39.png[/img]
a few details:
[list][*]the scenario saves after each combat, after each promotion, and when reorganizing varmints during the team select phase.[/*][*]tutorial state is never saved, but if you start yer run with the tutorial, you can pick up where you left off after you finish the tutorial[/*][*]there’s only one continue “slot” for now. starting a new game erases the old save.[/*][*]theoretically this feature works in the browser, but as you’ve probably noticed yer saved data gets erased pretty much at random, especially after i update the game which i do every three weeks or so these days. at this point i’d definitely recommend the downloaded version over the browser one.[/*][/list]
i know some of those gruelin’ runs can take a while, hopefully this helps you get through ’em on your own time.
[h3]changelog[/h3]
[list][*]added “continue game”!![/*][*]fixed a tooltip that LIED about what happens to reserve units (thanks @neomechanized)[/*][/list]
thanks fer readin’, and thanks fer playin’.

-cry

notes.title: v0.34.1 ~ floatin'
notes.content:
well howdy, pardners. it’s been a little while, ain’t it? still busy refactoring, but i figured i’d take a break to ship a new version with a new visual — nothin’ crazy, just a little somethin’ that makes the game a bit more fun and easier to understand.
[h2]floatin’ numbers[/h2]
good ol’ fashioned floatin’ numbers. you’ve seen ‘em a dozen times. well now, GG’s got ’em:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/74815245cf64a25d4c88c2a32ea133cb8530c17b.gif[/img]

when yer attack or hit points change, you get a little number floatin’ up. you also get a floatin’ notification when an ability is gained or lost, or simply when it fires:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/87622e7c7ea2d39ea3b0b3a20aef54cd86c2744a.gif[/img]

it’ll definitely help you keep track of just what the heck is goin’ on, especially at 1.5x and 2x speed.
[h2]changelog[/h2][list][*]balance: Desert Ghost’s “enervating toxin” card now removes Evasive, along with Tough, Quickdraw, and Archer[/*][*]fix: Extra Draw once again draws a card as soon as it’s applied, instead of, uh, doing nothing (thanks KingOfCharge)[/*][*]floating stat effects when a unit’s stats change[/*][*]shortened celebrations a little bit[/*][/list]
that’s all for now amigos. i appreciate your patience while i work to improve the codebase so i can add all sorts of new stuff without fear. thanks for readin’, and thanks for playin’.

-cry

notes.title: v0.33 ~ hold up... let him refactor
notes.content:
listen y’all, i’m knee deep in a codebase that currently looks like two different people wrote it who were born in two different geological eras so i don’t got no time fer my usual solid-gold comedy stylins shot through with pithy and informative patch notes, all gussied up with some of the most gosh-darned beautiful gifs y’ever laid eyes on.

so yeah i don’t got time fer that. uh, sorry. here’s the changelog

changelog
[list]
[*] soldier -> mercenary promotion now costs 2 bloom ribbons
[*] medic -> herbalist promotion now costs 3 bloom ribbons
[*] holding down spacebar (or enter) now continuously advances combat as if auto-advance were on
[*] ALL unit speech can now be dismissed at will. first click on the speech bubble makes them instantly complete their talkin’. second click pops da bubble.
[/list] 
thanks fer readin’ amigo, and thanks fer playin’. back to the mines!!

-cry

notes.title: v0.32 ~ cards? yeah. i sling those.
notes.content:
howdy pardners!! coupla little quality of life updates this go ’round.
[h2]yas, pardner[/h2]
what good is a cardslinger who ain’t slingin’ their cards? time was, you had to click ’em, then mouse on over to yer target, them click again. now… you can sling ’em:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/6541f53ef6a8c425e4ce99fd662c81e283408ea0.gif[/img]

also, cards that affect teams can now be played on any varmint on the team, instead of clickin’ the button.

of course, all the old interactions still work, so if you prefer clickin’ over draggin’, you’re still good to go.
[h2]click chads rejoice (spacebarcels seething)[/h2]
two small but hopefully experience-improving click-related changes:
[list][*]click on nothing to advance combat (you can still click the “next” button but you don’t have to)[/*][*]click on nothing to advance varmint speech in the tutorial[/*][/list][h2]changelog[/h2][list][*]add click to drag for playing cards[/*][*]added clicking anywhere to advance tutorial varmint speech[/*][*]added clicking anywhere to advance combat when “auto” is off[/*][*]removed twitter link (lmao)[/*][*]tweaked non-tutorial varmint speech to disappear a little quicker[/*][/list]
as always pardners, thanks fer readin’, and thanks fer playin’.

-cry

notes.title: v0.31 ~ it's a new dawn, it's a new day
notes.content:
howdy pardners! this week i gave the game a little spitshine, in addition to a few UI improvements, the background is lookin’ a heckuva lot more full these days, pardner.
[h2]background to the fore[/h2]
gone are the days where GG was played on a background of rocks and a weird sun spotlight. now we’ve got a proper [u]trail[/u] for these varmints to do battle on:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/c572dbf0ae7efae834c9766edaed145a55f6bf0e.png[/img]

currently the different spaces are just palette swaps of the same background, but in the full version each spot’ll have its own unique flair.
[h2]power promotions[/h2]
promotions used to be kyute. now they’re kyute and cool:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/d5f7b444a58462b46ad2b2841fe3314cadddb840.png[/img]
[h2]fan fire[/h2]
cards no longer line up all perfect. that kinda thing is a little unnatural, pardner. now they curve around a bit like you’d hold ’em in yer hand (and like cards are usually shown in games):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/cd0efbd148bc97528eb3722555a25aa7339329c8.png[/img]
[h2]changelog[/h2][list][*]newer, fancier backgrounds[/*][*]added some minor post-processing effects for important vibe-related purposes[/*][*]curved the cards in the hand[/*][*]added more flair to the promotion animation[/*][*]fix: overhead text no longer scales with varmint for readability[/*][*]fix: some UI elements were accidentally appearing above the varmint ledger[/*][*]fix: the “not in demo” job no longer shows job groups of the last-viewed job (thanks KingOfCharge)[/*][*]fix: various typos[/*][*]minor rebalancing of mercenary job[/*][/list]
that’s all fer now amigos. thanks fer readin’, and thanks fer playin’.

-cry

notes.title: v0.30 ~ get ledger'd
notes.content:
howdy, pardners. this is a bigger update n’ usual, taking two weeks fer me to git out the door instead of the usual one. the biggest change here are the updates to everyone’s favorite old west catalogue, the Varmint Ledger.
[h2]yer tellin’ me a varmint wrote this ledger?[/h2]
the varmint ledger is now available everywhere – and a heckuva lot more useful. click here while in-game to pull up the ledger:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/16203378b6e6245b439f9c05c80fa0f5f120d41f.gif[/img]
jobs in the ledger come in 4 flavors:
[list][*]you haven’t ever even seen this job – these are silhouettes and their names are unknown[/*][*]you’ve seen this job in promotion options, possibly even promoted a unit, but you haven’t used it in battle – these are darkened and their names are known, but not their details[/*][*]you’ve seen and used this job – you can see everything about ’em[/*][*]this job isn’t available in the demo – can’t see nuthin’, pardner![/*][/list]
click a job to see more about it in the brand new (but suspiciously familiar) “job info panel”:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/582b1219d62e863844965beca70786a1447f1474.gif[/img]
the panel on the side shows which jobs yer selected job promotes from, and promotes to, and you can click ’em to navigate to those as well:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/8df4a084ba53f2ff2c6c24fa508598a55ec9801d.gif[/img]
since this is a new feature, let me know in the Discord if you run into any related bugs while you’re messin’ around with it.
[h2]runnin’ buddies[/h2]
some cards and abilities depend on named groups that jobs belong to, like “outlaws”, “cynics”, or “villagers”. in this update we’ve got a few new ways to make sense of these.

hovering over a job will now show you which groups that job runs with. this is mostly useful when hovering over the job item in a unit’s tooltip:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/1a7ff18fe98d5f3f63ea6d3f2f9fd2da4a119293.png[/img]
i’ve also added group membership to the promotion chooser thingy (and the varmint ledger, of course):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/d4296f646ab7242af3f63cd547511ac749505870.png[/img]
[h2]changelog[/h2][list][*]brand new varmint ledger full o’ new goodies[/*][*]job groups visible from unit tooltip, promotion chooser and varmint ledger[/*][*]jobs that have been seen in promotion view are now “known” – they won’t appear as “???” in tooltips and menus[/*][*]varmint speech sound no longer ends abruptly[/*][*]FIX: varmint speech stays regular size when the varmint is scaled down[/*][*]FIX: varmints in the support crew no longer pop behind UI when swapping with varmint on the team[/*][/list]
thanks fer readin’, amigos, and thanks fer playin’.

-cry

notes.title: v0.29 ~ decks n' discards
notes.content:
howdy friends! this week’s update introduces something a lot of players have asked for: being able to see which cards are left in yer deck.

[h2]deck n’ discard piles[/h2]
when makin’ a plan during a battle, one of the most valuable bits of information is which cards are still in yer deck and could be drawn next turn, vs. the cards that are in yer discard pile and you won’t be seein’ anytime soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/36da95ac61166650396bcd43f10fc47cfc3c83ed.gif[/img]

now, the deck n’ discard pile – previously offscreen – are exposed in the preparation phase screen. just click ’em to see which cards are still in there, pardner.

[h2]changelog[/h2]

[list][*]added deck and discard piles to battle preparation screen[/*][*]added some pop-ups for wishlisting and the discord[/*][*]cards now tWiRl a lot[/*][*]fix: player can no longer go into debt with “Pay for Play” card[/*][*]fix: game progresses normally when a whole enemy squad is defeated with direct damage cards like Pay for Play and Spirit of Cigar[/*][*]fix: “movable” is disabled when a card is selected (no accidentally moving a mercenary while trying to play a card on them)[/*][*]balance: made “regular” and “rugged” a little more difficult by removing total number of tries[/*][*]fix: removed some really long varmint names that broke the UI[/*][*]varmints with no affordable promotions can now be selected so their promotions can be viewed[/*][*]re-scaled the volume sliders to be less loud overall[/*][/list]

thanks fer readin’, and thanks fer playin’.

-cry

notes.title: v0.28 ~ check yer deck
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/747272329aa6437776bb6fe7b1206a33d2d9a56b.png[/img]

howdy folks, cry here. couple of new things in this here update.

[h2]check the deck[/h2]
when you're putting your team together in the team select screen, one of the most important aspects of the decision is whose cards you want to be in the deck yer bringin' to the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44169985/1225be5e25e1617f72f36bc8551f8a74cdb0cd15.gif[/img]

well, now, you actually get to see that deck. colors represent the job that's contributin' them. mouse over a card, and you'll see its description text in a tooltip.

[h2]clearer cards[/h2]
some of these here cards have had descriptions that raised a few more questions than they answered. "give a varmint Sturdy"... is that fer the battle, or fer the combat round? make up yer mind, dagnabbit!!

fixed em up some.

[h2]turnin' tail[/h2]
running from battle was all kinds o' janked up. now it works as intended. specifically (thanks @mechanizedbush):
[list]
[*]yer little varmints jump up and skedaddle
[*]don't have to go through a combat round first
[*]varmints that went into combat winded, stay winded afterwards even if they ran
[/list]
[h2]smooth sailin'[/h2]
hoverin' over cards increases their size to make 'em easier to read, but on many systems that animation was a little, er, well it was janky.

not any more, pardner. now it's smooth as butter.

[h2]bug squashin'[/h2]
specifically, you shouldn't be able to have beaten "4 out of 3 scenarios..." (thanks @KingOfCharge)

thanks fer readin', friends, and thanks fer playin'.

-cry
